title: Frontend & full stack software engineer
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
ReactWise builds the software that chemists at 5 of the top 10 pharma companies use to optimize chemical processes, design high-throughput experiments, and replace toxic solvents. We are backed by Y Combinator and Innovate UK.


We are hiring two engineers in Cambridge, UK:


- Frontend engineer (React & TypeScript)
- Full Stack engineer


Why join:


- Your code reaches scientists at leading pharmaceutical companies within weeks
- Small team of chemists, ML engineers, and developers, so you work directly with the people who use what you build
- Mentorship from leading experts and advisors


‍


Full-time, start ASAP


Cambridge, UK - hybrid


£45k-£60k + equity


No visa sponsorship


Role descriptions and application links in the first comment.
